bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: Plan names and prices invisible on pricing page
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.root_cause: Card component applies text-[#0F172A] (dark navy) which inherited to h3 and price spans, making them invisible against bg-[#111826] dark background
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Added explicit text-white class to all h3 and price span elements in PricingPagePublic.js

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: Webstore plan pages had broken back links
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.root_cause: Back links pointed to /webstores instead of /webstores-overview
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Updated href to /webstores-overview in WebstoreLaunchPage.js, WebstoreGrowthPage.js, WebstoreScalePage.js

critical_code_review_comments: Card component at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/card.jsx has default light theme styling (text-[#0F172A], bg-[#F5F7FA]) which conflicts with dark-themed marketing pages. Consider adding a dark variant or ensuring explicit color classes are used when Card is on dark backgrounds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketing site restructure with three product lines (SignGuy AI OS, SignGuy Webstores, SignGuy AI Studio) is complete. All routes work correctly. Annual pricing is ONLY shown on Business plan page. Other plans (OS Starter/Pro, Webstore Launch/Growth/Scale, AI Basic/Pro/Max) only show monthly pricing. The webstores marketing route is /webstores-overview to avoid conflict with in-app /webstores feature.
